title: Ultra-long-range interactions between active regulatory elements.
authors: Friman, Elias T; Flyamer, Ilya M; Marenduzzo, Davide; Boyle, Shelagh; Bickmore, Wendy A
one_liner_zh: 该文利用Hi-C数据与数百个DNA结合因子分析，揭示活性调控元件间的超长距离染色质互作，并通过模拟提出桥接诱导聚集模型，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合因子与互作建模，但核心是染色质三维结构而非TF-DNA特异性结合机制，方法上模拟可借鉴但非AI/物理模拟聚焦。
abstract: Contacts between enhancers and promoters are thought to relate to their ability to activate transcription. Investigating factors that contribute to such chromatin interactions is therefore important for understanding gene regulation. Here, we have determined contact frequencies between millions of pairs of cis-regulatory elements from chromosome conformation capture data sets and analyzed a collection of hundreds of DNA-binding factors for binding at regions of enriched contacts. This analysis revealed enriched contacts at sites bound by many factors associated with active transcription. We show that active regulatory elements, independent of cohesin and polycomb, interact with each other across distances of tens of megabases in vertebrate and invertebrate genomes and that interactions correlate and change with activity. However, these ultra-long-range interactions are not dependent on RNA polymerase II transcription or individual transcription cofactors. Using simulations, we show that a model of chromatin and multivalent binding factors can give rise to long-range interactions via bridging-induced clustering. We propose that long-range interactions between cis-regulatory elements are driven by at least three distinct processes: cohesin-mediated loop extrusion, polycomb contacts, and clustering of active regions.
abstract_zh: 增强子与启动子之间的接触被认为与其激活转录的能力相关。因此，研究促成此类染色质相互作用的因素对于理解基因调控至关重要。在此，我们基于染色体构象捕获数据集确定了数百万对顺式调控元件之间的接触频率，并分析了数百种DNA结合因子在富集接触区域的结合情况。该分析揭示了在多种与活跃转录相关的因子结合位点处存在富集接触。我们表明，活跃调控元件，独立于黏连蛋白和polycomb，在脊椎动物和无脊椎动物基因组中跨越数十兆碱基的距离相互作用，且这些相互作用与活性相关并随活性变化。然而，这些超长距离相互作用不依赖于RNA聚合酶II转录或单个转录辅因子。通过模拟，我们展示了染色质和多价结合因子的模型可通过桥接诱导聚类产生长距离相互作用。我们提出，顺式调控元件之间的长距离相互作用由至少三个不同过程驱动：黏连蛋白介导的环挤出、polycomb接触以及活跃区域的聚类。
